title: Mbaka language - Wikipedia
text: The Mbaka or Bwaka language, Ngbaka Ma'bo (also called Gbaka, Ma'bo, Ngbwaka, Ngbaka Limba) is a major Ubangian language spoken by the Mbaka people of CAR and Congo. It is not clear how distinct the Gilima variety is, or whether it should be considered a separate language.

title: Mbaka language
